name: mythicmons-team-lab
description: Showdown-backed battle experiment harness for entertainment team strength testing.

scripts.smoke:simulate: npm run simulate -- --teamA examples/teamA.txt --teamB examples/teamB.txt --seed 123 --ai basic --out output/smoke
scripts.smoke:evaluate: npm run evaluate -- --team examples/teamA.txt --benchmarks benchmarks/gen9ou/index.json --seed 123 --games 1 --ai basic --out output/eval-smoke
scripts.smoke:variants: npm run variants -- --team examples/teamA.txt --benchmarks benchmarks/gen9ou/index.json --seed 123 --games 1 --ai basic --kinds item --limit 2 --out output/variants-smoke
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:boss && npm run smoke:tactical-memory && npm run smoke:lineups && npm run smoke:strategy-program && npm run smoke:parallel-registry && npm run smoke:season-brief && npm run test:regressions && npm run smoke:simulate && npm run smoke:evaluate && npm run smoke:variants && npm run smoke:sandbox && npm run smoke:dynasty && npm run smoke:v9 && npm run smoke:v10 && npm run smoke:v10-audit && npm run smoke:v11 && npm run smoke:v12
